name: Corsath Murmur [Racial]
body:
What was that? Sounds like an arrow to the eardrum.

Prerequisite(s): Corsath, whisper, Stealth 9 ranks

Benefits: You may make sniping attacks at no penalty to Stealth checks. Attempts to eavesdrop on your conversations automatically fail.

A Land Out of Time 2013, Little Red Goblin Games LLC, Authors: Caleb Aylsworth, Scott Gladstein, Dayton Johnson, Caleb Aylsworth, Jeremiah Zerby
